name: Enthrall

targets.description: creatures of your choice that you can see; any creature you or your companions are fighting succeeds automatically

summary: Creatures of your choice make a Wis save or take -10 to Perception checks and Passive Perception.
text: You spin a captivating stream of words. Creatures of your choice that you can see within range make a Wisdom saving throw; any creature that you or your companions are fighting succeeds automatically. On a failure, a creature has a -10 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks and to its Passive Perception until the spell ends. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
